transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um, thank you so much for seeing me. I hope I'm in the right place. I just... I want to make sure I'm doing what I'm supposed to do, because things have been a little stressful lately and I really don't want to be a bother to anyone. 

I work as a mechanic, and recently, I've been... well, I've been hearing this man's voice. I know that probably sounds really strange, I'm so sorry. But it sounds like it's coming right out of the garage vents at the shop, and sometimes even from under the hood of the cars. It's as clear as somebody standing right next to me. 

And, um... he keeps telling me not to trust my husband, and that I shouldn't touch certain cars. I've been trying really hard to just do my job and ignore it so I don't cause any problems, but it's getting a bit hard to deal with. Does that... is that the kind of thing I should be telling you? I hope I'm explaining it okay.
About how long have you been hearing this voice?

Um, well... I guess it's been a little while. I'm sorry, I know I probably should have come in a lot sooner, I just really didn't want to make a fuss or worry anybody. 

But, um... the voice, and... well, I've also been having these thoughts that I'm being tracked... they've both been happening for about ten months now. I really tried to just ignore it all and do a good job at work so I wouldn't be a problem for my boss. I hope it's okay that I waited this long to tell someone. Is that... is ten months the kind of timeline you were looking for?
Over these past ten months, have you noticed any significant changes in your mood, such as feeling persistently down or depressed?

Um, no, I don't... I don't think so. I really try my best to keep a positive attitude, you know? I don't want to be a downer for the guys at the shop or, um, for my husband. So I wouldn't say I've felt persistently down or depressed. I try to just keep smiling and do my work. 

I hope that's okay? Like, I hope I'm not supposed to be feeling sad with everything else going on... I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right information. Is that helpful?
Have you used any recreational drugs, alcohol, or new medications around the time these experiences started?

Um, no. No, definitely not. I really try to take good care of myself, you know? I don't use any recreational drugs at all, and I only ever have maybe one glass of wine if we're celebrating something, but that's very rare. I want to make sure I'm always clear-headed for work so I don't mess up anyone's car. 

And, um, I haven't started any new medications either. I just take my regular daily vitamin. I know some people use things to cope when they're stressed, but I promise I haven't been doing anything like that. I hope that's a good thing? Like, I hope it helps that my system is clean, so we can figure this out. Did I answer that right?
Have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions, or had any major physical illnesses or head injuries?

Um, no, nothing like that. I've always been pretty healthy, thankfully. I try really hard to be careful at the shop, you know, wearing my safety glasses and steel-toe boots so I don't get hurt or cause any problems for anyone else. 

So, no major illnesses or head injuries or anything. I hope that's helpful for you? I just want to make sure I'm giving you all the right pieces so you can do your job. Is it okay that I don't have any medical history like that to report?
